description: 2026-11-27 (operator): 'Sleeping here' marks a room where someone is asleep; the climate loop keeps its AC from blowing air there, and other automations (lights) may read it too. It clears itself at 12:00 so a forgotten toggle cannot leave a room unheated for days (the safety band still holds 18 C meanwhile). Design: docs/climate-control-design.md, v6.2.
